name: usine
description: Run coding agents on your GitHub issues and pull requests, on your own machines.

scripts.check: node scripts/docs/check.mjs && turbo run check --concurrency=1 && node scripts/worker-image/generate.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @usine/docs openapi:check && git diff --exit-code -- apps/docs/public/openapi.json
scripts.changeset:publish: pnpm build && pnpm stage publish -r --tag latest --no-git-checks && node scripts/release/tag.mjs
scripts.test:scripts: node --experimental-strip-types --test tooling/test/*.test.mts scripts/ci/*.test.mjs scripts/docs/*.test.mjs scripts/release/*.test.mjs scripts/effect-diagnostics/*.test.mjs infra/hetzner/gateway/test/*.test.mjs infra/boat/test/*.test.mjs infra/boxd/test/*.test.mjs infra/worker-image/test/*.test.mjs
